dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic spline curvature along the trailing edge from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded vertex with a narrow pixel radius, forming the transition between the convex leading edge and concave trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior slope at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, gradual convex arc originating from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust terminal projection with a low length-to-thickness ratio (approx 1:2).
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 155 degrees at the junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lateral tonal gradient between dark dorsal pigmentation and lighter gray-green lateral flanks.
